It sits alongside a quickstart and Postman tooling for making API calls (brex-docs-5, brex-docs-22), which matches the story's core directly. The evidence is a one-line catalog entry, so depth is unverified. missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation of which accounting objects can be viewed or modified, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Accounting API in use.
